new_value: {"notes":"Added an isolated format-v2 canonical-vector host receiver gate and fixed the one parity defect it exposed. On RCS failure, Zephyr C now distinguishes a complete contiguous regular prefix (request corrupt All-1 retransmission with bitmap bit 0 clear) from a possibly missing regular suffix (mark All-1 received and request regular tiles), matching RFC 8724 behavior and the Rust/Python implementations. Coverage includes loss plus ACK recovery, reverse-order delivery across W=1, identical and conflicting duplicates, corrupt-All1 RCS failure, timeout/Receiver-Abort, undersized response state/output atomicity, constrained receiver rejection, exact packet delivery, 1,281 and 22,554 limits, and invalid 22,555 configuration. Evidence: AppleClang UBSan CMake/CTest 1/1; Python format-v2 integrity/production 41/41; isolated Rust fragmentation_vectors with std,raw-fragment-codec 2/2; local Zephyr 4.1 nRF52840 schc_generic incremental full link passed (139,561 B flash, 31,872 B RAM); cppcheck and git diff --check passed. No collision or blocker."}
